_about: Crissa's kit (2026-10-09, the parity build): what the reference install's front door runs that krew did not ship: her Decide watch (the needs-zoey-watch cron's monitor script, prompt pinned from it), the spoken tool callout hook, her computer-use ceiling, the Oracle tools (krew-oracle), the Crissa voice tiers as a streaming TTS provider (krew-tts), the Hindsight plugin pin, and the STT command for a voice note (krew-stt-cli.py, written for krew: the reference named a script that no longer existed). docs/ZOEY-KIT.md rides the docs-contracts package (docs/*.md).

zoey-kit.about: crew/scripts/zoey-needs-watch.py (her Decide watch's monitor: presence through the Wall's player + the open escalation cards; CRON_PROMPT + install_cron_prompt), crew/scripts/zoey-tool-callout.py (one spoken line per tool start, through the player's /v1/announce), crew/scripts/krew-stt-cli.py (a voice note through the Crissa ASR), crew/config/zoey-cua-manifest.yaml (her hands' ceiling, copied by init), crew/hindsight/plugin-pin.json.

krew-oracle.about: oracle_presence, oracle_inspect, oracle_visit, oracle_chase_auth, oracle_embed, oracle_look_at, oracle_name_face, error-check on toolset team: the Oracle visit loop's tools, HTTP to the Wall's player (presence) and the presence service's own address (camera verbs, when configured).

krew-tts.about: The Crissa voice tiers (turbo, audio8, pocket, kokoro; the first that answers) as the `zoeyos` streaming TTS provider; local-first priority; a loud note when streaming falls back.
